settings.text: Back to school sale - Free shipping on all orders

settings.heading: Track your
settings.text: Follow your Dream Drops from our warehouse to your door.

settings.title: Check your inbox
settings.text: When your order ships, we send an email with your tracking number and a link to follow your parcel.

settings.title: Log in to your account
settings.text: Sign in with the email you ordered with to see every order, its status and its tracking details.

settings.title: Still can't find it?
settings.text: Send us your order number and email address and we'll find out exactly where your parcel is.

settings.question: When will my order ship?
settings.answer: Orders are usually packed and dispatched within 1–2 business days. We email you a tracking link as soon as yours is on its way.

settings.question: I can't find my shipping email.
settings.answer: Check your spam or promotions folder for an email from us. If it isn't there, send us your order number and we'll look it up.

settings.question: My tracking hasn't updated for a few days.
settings.answer: Tracking can pause while a parcel moves between carriers. If there's no update after 5 business days, contact us and we'll chase it with the carrier.

settings.question: I entered the wrong address.
settings.answer: Contact us straight away with your order number. If the order hasn't been dispatched yet, we can update the address for you.

settings.heading: Still need
settings.text: Our team reads every message and will get back to you as soon as we can.
